golden_rules.query: What is the minimum speed for accurate data collection?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify speed readings at low speeds using calibrated reference
golden_rules.failure_indication: Inaccurate or no speed readings below 0.3 knots

golden_rules.query: What is the maximum speed limit for accurate readings?
golden_rules.test_method: Verify speed readings at high speeds using calibrated reference
golden_rules.failure_indication: Inaccurate readings above 45 knots

golden_rules.query: What is the speed data output frequency?
golden_rules.test_method: Measure data output frequency using diagnostic tools
golden_rules.failure_indication: Speed updates slower than 5 times per second

golden_rules.query: Is the device properly connected to CAST app?
golden_rules.test_method: Attempt to connect and calibrate through CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Unable to establish wireless connection or frequent disconnects

golden_rules.query: Does the attitude sensor detect heel and trim?
golden_rules.expected_value: Accurate heel and trim readings within operational range
golden_rules.test_method: Compare sensor readings to known vessel attitude
golden_rules.failure_indication: Missing or inaccurate heel and trim data

golden_rules.query: Is device compliant with marine electronics standards?
golden_rules.test_method: Check certification documentation
golden_rules.failure_indication: Device not certified for marine use

golden_rules.test_method: Compare speed sensor reading to specification

golden_rules.query: Is temperature reading within operational range?
golden_rules.test_method: Compare temperature reading to specification
golden_rules.failure_indication: Temperature readings unreliable or out of range

golden_rules.query: Is speed calibration complete for all required angles?
golden_rules.expected_value: Calibrated at 5 heel angles and up to 10 speeds
golden_rules.test_method: Check calibration settings in CAST app
golden_rules.failure_indication: Incomplete speed calibration

golden_rules.query: Is device transmitting heartbeat PGN?
golden_rules.test_method: Monitor NMEA 2000 network traffic
golden_rules.failure_indication: Device not properly connected to network

golden_rules.query: Is self-closing valve functioning?

golden_rules.test_method: Remove insert and check for water flow
